title: Hutchins-Style Brisket

items: 11-12 lb brisket, wet aged for 40 days

steps: Trim the brisket.  Always trim the brisket straight out of the fridge when it's cold. Much easier to cut the fat when it's cold.  Keep 1/4" of the fat on for Prime beef, or ½” of the fat for Choice beef.
Remove the dekel, if it has one. Get rid of most of the hard fat around the brisket. Optionally, remove the silverskin as well.
Do not apply the rub until right before you're going to smoke the brisket, and do it when the brisket has reached room temperature. This will be around 2 hours sitting at room temp.
Mix 2/3 ratio yellow mustard with 1/3 ratio pickle juice and spread all over the brisket.
Mix 2/3 ratio black pepper with 1/3 ratio salt and sprinkle onto the brisket liberally.
Smoke the brisket at 225 degrees, fat side up.
The first 4 hours should use post oak and the rest of the time should be with pecan.
Cook the brisket to 175-180 F internal temperature. This is about 1 hour per pound of brisket.
(for Choice brisket with 1/2" of fat - cook at 350 degrees for 2-3 hours to get a nice sear/bubbling fat layer; then reduce temperature to 225 degrees and continue with the above instructions.)
Rest open on a sheet pan for 2-2.5 hours or until the internal temperature reaches 145.
Spray the brisket with apple juice or brisket drippings, then wrap in unwaxed butcher paper and rest for 4.5 hours in the oven at 140F
